rec.name: Collection Page Spotlight (in-grid banner, video, product and reviews tiles)
rec.status: Built — delivered and tested; theme-specific install docs still being refined

what.text: A 'Spotlight' tile that sits inside the collection product grid at an editable position. It breaks up the grid with a highlighted content tile. The ticket describes four variants: (1) a category banner with headline, sub-headline, optional button and link, (2) a benefits/info banner with text over an image, (3) a highlighted product tile with an optional full-width add-to-cart button, and (4) a reviews tile with a rating summary and a testimonial card. The final code ships as four blocks of the collection products section: Spotlight, Spotlight video, Spotlight product and Spotlight reviews. Video was added beyond the original ticket. Each block has separate desktop and mobile visibility and a grid position.

why.text: Native-looking tiles inside the product grid interrupt scrolling without pulling the shopper off the page. A banner can communicate a category benefit or lead time, and a highlighted bestseller tile gets extra attention. A reviews tile puts social proof right where shoppers compare products, which lowers purchase anxiety. Repeating the tile on every page of results keeps the message visible during long browsing sessions.

how.text: Add the block definitions (spotlight, spotlight_video, spotlight_product, spotlight_reviews) to the 'blocks' array of the schema in the theme's collection products section. Then create the snippet ed-collection-spotlight.liquid and render it inside the product loop whenever the loop index matches a block's 'position' setting. If 'repeat_position' is on, the tile repeats on every page. Merchants then add and configure the blocks in the theme customizer. CSS custom properties are scoped per block ID and set height, padding, border radius, text colour and background overlay. The 'Show at Desktop only' and 'Show at Mobile only' checkboxes hide the tile via media queries at the 1000px breakpoint. 'Full-width at Mobile' makes the tile span both grid columns. The dev notes say the install steps differ by theme: you must first find the correct collection template and section, and a developer is needed. The code supplied in the ticket is truncated, so the rendering loop and the product and reviews snippet markup are not visible.

items: Position in grid (1–20) and 'Repeat spotlight on each page' (default on)
Show on desktop only / mobile only (separate desktop and mobile control), plus full-width on mobile
Spotlight (banner) block: show button yes/no (originally labelled 'Classic/Modern', relabelled after feedback), height % (desktop) and px (mobile), padding, border radius
Background colour and overlay opacity; background image for desktop and a separate one for mobile
Heading (rich text), heading size H1–H6, normal/uppercase, line height; content text with desktop and mobile font size and top spacing; text colour
Button text, URL, open in new tab, type (primary/secondary/outline), style (default/rounded/circle), optional arrow icon (custom SVG)
Video block: cover image, video, autoplay, mute, loop, mobile height in vh
Product block: product picker and 'Show full-width ATC button'

Reviews block: custom Liquid slot for a Reviews.io widget, or default content with heading colours, title, star rating, rating text, testimonial author, stars, verified label, quote and date, plus section background
Limit of 6 of each block type

dependencies.text: Needs a theme whose collection section has an editable block schema and a product loop. Installation is theme-specific and needs a developer, since it must be adapted per theme. It was built for the Concept, Broadcast and FOCAL themes. The ticket flags 'metafield needed: yes', but the supplied code uses no metafields; this is unclear (X). The reviews variant optionally uses a Reviews.io widget pasted into the Liquid field, or manual default content. The snippet is ed-collection-spotlight.liquid.

items: Spotlight click-through rate (banner, button and product tile)
Add-to-cart rate from the spotlight product tile
Collection conversion rate and revenue per session
Scroll depth and bounce rate on collection pages

images.caption: Banner Spotlight tile ('Headphones Accessories') as the 4th tile in a collection product grid: headline, sub-headline and an outline pill button with arrow over a darkened background image.
Benefits-style spotlight: a full-bleed image with centred overlay text about stock and lead time.
Highlighted product tile on mobile (bestseller): large product card with badge, rating, price, variant selector and a full-width add-to-cart button.
Reviews spotlight: black rating summary box (title, stars, 4.8/5 with review count, Reviews.io logo) over a white testimonial card with verified-customer label and date.
Theme customizer block settings: an early version with a 'Layout style' Classic/Modern toggle, later relabelled as 'Show button' Yes/No.
